<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope—a dominant peak with a ~9 % M+1 peak and rapidly decreasing higher‑mass peaks—the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution for a molecule containing roughly 8–9 carbons. No characteristic M+2 peaks for Cl, Br, S, etc., are present, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
